1. This is applicant's first application under Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail, as She is apprehending her arrest in connection with Crime No.184/2024 registered at Police Station Nalcha, District Dhar (MP) for offence punishable under Section 366,
376(2)(n) and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. Allegations against the applicant is she was also involved in the aforesaid case wherein, the main allegation is against her brother Kanha who took the prosecutrix aged 24 years from Indore to Hariyana and the prosecutrix was recovered after around 20 days.
3. Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the only allegation against the present applicant is that the main accused and the prosecutrix resided in her house for a couple of days.

It is also submitted that the main accused Kanha has already been granted regular bail by the trial Court vide order dated 02/07/2024 and in such circumstances, when there is no overt act attributed to the present applicant, her custodial interrogation is not necessary.
Hence, it is 2 MCRC-28887-2024 submitted that the application be allowed and she be released on anticipatory bail.

4. Counsel for the respondent / State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that no case for anticipatory bail is made out.
5.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant shall be released on bail, upon his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only) and furnishing one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
